question.worked_solution:
We "factor out" the given determinant from the determinant we would like to find:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}a+4 & 5 \\ b+2 & -3\end{aligned}| & =|\begin{aligned}(a+5)-1 & 5 \\ b+2 & -3\end{aligned}|\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the linearity property of determinants, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}(a+5)-1 & 5 \\ b+2 & -3\end{aligned}| & ={{|\begin{aligned}a+5 & 5 \\ b & -3\end{aligned}|}_{⏟}}_{-34}+|\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 \\ 2 & -3\end{aligned}| \\  & =-34+(3-10) \\  & =-41.\end{aligned}
$$
